name: Isoleucine
info: A BCAA with two chiral centers. It has the same molecular formula as leucine.

history.clue: The name indicates that it is an isomer of leucine.
history.story: In the early twentieth century, chemists noticed that different batches of isolated leucine differed in solubility and optical rotation. In 1903, Felix Ehrlich established the presence of another amino acid: isoleucine. Its name means an isomer of leucine; the formula is the same, but the carbon chain branches differently.
